skill_name: Create a short story about a student who is struggling with Chemistry
workflow: John was a brilliant student with a hardworking nature. But in Chemistry, he was struggling to keep up. He was confused by the formulas and equations in the book and the lectures seemed to flow over his head at times. He tried his best to stay focused in class and listen carefully but the subject often seemed daunting to him.
